# Upstream-owned test files (or nodes) scripts/run_tests_bundled.py does NOT run unless
# the file is named on the command line (owner ruling 2026-10-05; plan
# docs/agent-runtime-harness/planned/suite-speed-2026-10-05.md §3 Stage 1, O1).
#
# One row per NODE: `path::node · why · upstream SHA`, the three fields separated
# by " · " — the file still runs and only that node is deselected. A FILE row
# (`path · why · upstream SHA`) keeps the whole file out, and is only for a file
# that hangs, freezes or cannot collect, or whose subject is `unused`; a file row whose `why` names one of the
# file's tests is refused (tests/scripts/test_upstream_skip_list.py). `why` starts with a class word the weekly merge lane keys its re-check
# on (Harness_Brain/50 — Agent Handoffs/Merging upstream.md, step 5b):
#   P0       — a freeze candidate: re-run only under the watchdog/VM the P0 row names
#   env      — environmental (provider-network hang, WSL bash shadow, missing acp/ripgrep): re-run bare
#   upstream — an upstream bug, with its issue/PR link: re-run bare, drop when green
#   unused   — a feature the fork does not ship (Harness_Brain/30 — Decisions/0015); cites "ADR 0015";
#              any upstream file may carry it; the release merge lists unused files upstream added/removed
# `upstream SHA` is the upstream/main tip the red was recorded against.
#
# Every path is in tests/fixtures/upstream_manifest.txt. A FORK file is never
# listed — fork reds are fixed, not skipped (tests/scripts/test_upstream_skip_list.py).
# A row is evidence, not a memory: an `env`/`upstream` row is added only after
# the file was run once, bare, and seen red on origin/main.

tests/hermes_cli/test_source_check.py · P0: in flight at both 2026-10-05 workstation hard freezes (fork-hygiene-queue P0 row); run only under a watchdog/VM · ee5f49b943
tests/hermes_cli/test_source_launcher_publication.py · P0: same freeze set; republishes the running hermes.exe (h10-fhrel verdict) · ee5f49b943
tests/hermes_cli/test_source_release_channels.py · P0: same freeze set · ee5f49b943
tests/hermes_cli/test_source_release_probe.py · P0: same freeze set · ee5f49b943
tests/hermes_cli/test_update_completion_process.py · upstream: nondeterministic on Windows - 8-9 of its update-completion tests red on the pure tag v0.21.6 and on main, a different set each run (lock and child-process timing), so per-test strict marks XPASS; re-run bare at each release (2026-10-10) · d923a5eb48
